sentences.text:
CORAM: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath ---
For the Petitioner: Md. Razaullah Ansari, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Shailesh Kr. Sinha, A.P.P.
---
02 / 10.12.2024 Heard the parties.
2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. No. 570 of 2024 arising out of Mahila P.S. Bundu Case No. 5 of 2024 for the offences registered under sections 376(2) (n) and 417 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned A.J.C-VI-cum-Special Judge (CAW), FTC,
Ranchi.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is a major lady.
Petitioner had promised to marry the prosecutrix, but subsequently, he refused to do so.
4. It appears that the parties were in physical relationship for about nine years.

5. In view of the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned A.J.C-VI-cum-Special Judge (CAW), FTC, Ranchi in connection with S.T. No. 570 of 2024 arising out of Mahila P.S. Bundu Case No. 5 of 2024.
